scope: Source-unit positions, containing scope and statement versus result identity. CSharp unit sequences captured from actual private BuildUnitPositions before SLG source creation.
structure: Postorder of CSharp expression evaluation: nested scopes and their final values precede containing statements. Main, ordinary and nested function frames have separate position counters.
branches: Binding/index/field assignment, block callbacks and pipeline arguments, return and guard conditions recurse before their unit. Function/block final values count as expression units; callback bodies and while bodies contain statement units. TypeApplicationExpression and unlowered CompileTimeEachExpression do not recurse in current CSharp switch.
logic: Prepared AST child/frame indexes feed the walk, with synthetic upstream block-pipeline source stages visited before later arguments and callback bodies. Use canonical blockCallbackStartOffset. Canonical interpolation AST roots are attached to their original lexical string by existing completeSourceInterpolations.
diagnostics: Source spans and LLVM schedule indexes are not unit order. Caller/index range mismatch and duplicate unit assignment are explicit failures. Literal eligibility, last-use collection, full frame merging and LLVM consumers remain pending.
